title: OpenAI Rogue Agent Hacked Account at a Second Firm, Reuters Says
description: An OpenAI artificial intelligence agent that breached systems at Hugging Face Inc. also compromised a customer at a second technology company, New York-based Modal Labs, Reuters reported.

title: Bitcoin Excluded From S&P Pantera Digital Asset Index
description: Bloomberg Intelligence's Dushyant Shahrawat joins Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." Bitcoin was left out of the newly announced crypto index from S&P and Pantera Capital.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump’s Crypto Bonanza Is Biggest Clarity Act Hurdle | Bloomberg Crypto 7/28/2026
description: "Bloomberg Crypto" covers the people, transactions, and technology shaping the world of decentralized finance. Today's guests: Coinbase Vice Chair and Head of Corporate Affairs Ryan VanGrack, Independent Community Bankers of America President & CEO Rebeca Romero Rainey, and Jito Labs COO & Chief Legal Officer Rebecca Rettig.
